findings.proposition: The December 2023 settlement of Synergy CHC Corp. v. HVL, LLC d/b/a Atrium Innovations created a loan payable of $5,450,000. At June 30, 2024 the outstanding balance was $4,802,445, and the schedule requires $2,000,000 in 2024, $2,000,000 in 2025 and $802,445 in 2026. Linking the Note 11 '$5,450,000 December 28, 2023 Loan' (described as a settlement with a 'former supplier') to Atrium, and to the 'Atrium' row in the notes-payable table, is an inference based on Note 13's cross-reference and the matching $5,450,000 and $4,802,445 amounts. The unchanged balance between Dec 31, 2023 and June 30, 2024 suggests that none of the 2024 installment was paid by June 30 (also an inference).

effects.double_count_guard: This does not change the existing Knight schedule (no 2024 principal due). It only governs whether the new advance is permitted and the risk of acceleration or cross-default. Do not assume acceleration, and do not assume the advance ranks senior.
effects.model_consequence: Without Knight's consent, any of the permitted offers could breach the Knight covenant. Knight's loan is senior-secured on all assets, so the advance would rank behind it, and a breach could trigger default provisions tied to a $12.3M loan and cross-default into the Sanders loan. None of the offers can be treated as permissible until consent is confirmed.
